definition.def: If you appreciate something, for example a piece of music or good food, you like it because you recognize its good qualities.
examples: Anyone can appreciate our music. [VERB noun]
In time you'll appreciate the beauty and subtlety of this language. [VERB noun]

definition.def: If you appreciate a situation or problem, you understand it and know what it involves.
examples: I never really appreciated the size of the club and what it means to the community. [VERB noun]
He appreciates that co-operation with the media is part of his professional duties. [VERB that]

definition.def: If you appreciate something that someone has done for you or is going to do for you, you are grateful for it.
examples: Peter stood by me when I most needed it. I'll always appreciate that. [VERB noun]
Thanks, lads. I appreciate it. [VERB noun]
I'd appreciate it if you wouldn't mention it. [VERB noun]

definition.def: If something that you own appreciates over a period of time, its value increases.
examples: They don't have any confidence that houses will appreciate in value. [VERB]
